en.headline: Overall crime rises 2.1 percent in first three quarters, driven by fraud
en.dek: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said 68,015 cases were recorded from January to September, with fraud accounting for nearly half at 34,679 cases.
body: Secretary for Security Chris Tang said on Thursday that overall crime in Hong Kong rose 2.1 percent year on year in the first three quarters of 2026, reaching 68,015 cases.

Tang told reporters after a meeting of the Fight Crime Committee that the increase was mainly driven by fraud. There were 34,679 fraud cases, up 7.9 percent, involving losses of HK$6.02 billion, a rise of 6.7 percent. Phone scams surged in August and September, with nearly 3,900 cases in those two months, about 80 percent of them fake customer-service calls.

Most other categories fell. Traditional crimes such as burglary, robbery and theft declined by between 3.5 and 39.2 percent, and cases of robbery and snatching reached a record low. Investment scams dropped 28.6 percent to 2,947 cases, while technology-related crimes fell 11.5 percent to 21,573.

Tang said the figures showed that conventional crime remained under control even as fraud continued to pose a challenge. Police have been stepping up public education and enforcement against telephone and online deception.

zh.headline: 首三季罪案升2.1% 詐騙案帶動整體上升
zh.dek: 保安局局長鄧炳強表示，今年1月至9月錄得68015宗罪案，詐騙案佔近一半，共34679宗。
body: 保安局局長鄧炳強周四表示，本港今年首三季整體罪案按年上升2.1%，達68015宗。
鄧炳強在撲滅罪行委員會會議後會見傳媒時說，升幅主要由詐騙案帶動。詐騙案有34679宗，按年升7.9%，涉及損失60.2億元，升6.7%。8月及9月電話騙案急增，兩個月近3900宗，當中約八成為假冒客服。
大部分其他罪案均下跌。爆竊、行劫及盜竊等傳統罪案跌幅介乎3.5%至39.2%，行劫及搶掠更創歷史新低。投資騙案跌28.6%至2947宗，科技罪案跌11.5%至21573宗。
鄧炳強指出，數字反映傳統罪案仍受控，但詐騙持續構成挑戰。警方一直加強公眾教育及針對電話和網上詐騙的執法。
